newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were called to open mostly flat Thursday, dealers said.

Follow-through short-covering by the funds could lift prices during the session, they added. Wednesday, the spot-month racked up sharp gains when short-covering lifted the contract through 10.47-10.50, and then above key 10.54.

On Wednesday, March settled 0.14 cent higher at 10.58 cents a lb, having ranged from 10.62 to 10.49 cents a lb. The deferred contracts ended 0.13 to 0.01 firmer. Volume was estimated at a brisk 23,7681 lots.
The market closed at its highest level since Jan 15, when March settled at 10.62.
Resistance basis March is now seen at 10.70 cents, the high made Jan 16.

LIFFE white sugar was higher in afternoon trade, with activity centered around the March/May spread ahead of the spot expiry. At 0845 EST/1345 GMT, March was up $1.40 at $304.90. The back months were $0.70 higher to $0.40 lower.
